name: Shortsword
description: A balanced steel blade for close-quarters combat.

name: Iron Mace
description: Heavy flanged iron head favored by templars and clerics.

name: Throwing Daggers
description: Balanced bandolier of daggers usable in melee or thrown from the back row.

name: Hunting Shortbow
description: Light recurve bow capable of striking from either row.

name: Lead-Shot Sling
description: Simple braided sling that lets back-row healers hurl heavy lead bullets.

name: Apprentice Wand-Staff
description: Focuses arcane sparks from any row and expands the wielder's mana pool.

name: Boar Spear
description: Long ash-shafted polearm with reach to strike from the front or back row.

name: Duelist Rapier
description: Needle-sharp thrusting sword that scales with agility and accuracy.

name: Knight's Broadsword
description: Crucible-steel martial blade forged in Oakhaven's royal armory.

name: Crusader Warhammer
description: Crushing warhammer built to dent shields and shatter undead bones.

name: Yew War Longbow
description: Masterwork heartwood longbow crafted by the bowyers of Yew.

name: Sunburst Scepter
description: Sanctified long-handled mace that radiates holy reach and bolsters Divine WIS.

name: Vanguard Halberd
description: Heavy pole-axe that cleaves foes from either the front or back line.

name: Corsair Crossbow
description: Winch-drawn steel arbalest favored by sharpshooters in Port of Moon.

name: Runed Arcane Rod
description: Silver-inlaid rod that hurls searing bolts of force and deepens arcane reserves.

name: Avalon Greatsword
description: Two-handed champion's blade of unmatched front-line devastation.

name: Apprentice Robe
description: Woven wool robe stitched with minor warding runes.

name: Acolyte Vestments
description: Blessed temple garments worn by initiates of the Triad.

name: Cured Leather Armor
description: Supple boiled-leather cuirass that protects without hindering movement.

name: Studded Brigandine
description: Reinforced leather riveted with steel bosses.

name: Starweave Vestment
description: Shimmering astral silk that deflects blades and amplifies spellcraft.

name: Nightstalker Cuirass
description: Darkened wyvern-hide armor tailored for scouts and cutpurses.

name: Chainmail Hauberk
description: Interlocking steel rings over a padded gambeson.

name: Templar Scale Mail
description: Overlapping bronze-and-steel scales consecrated at Oakhaven Temple.

name: Royal Plate Armor
description: Full articulated steel plate worn by the Vanguard of Castle Avalon.

name: Ring of Protection +1
description: Silver band that projects a subtle ward against incoming blows (+1 AC).

name: Gauntlets of Ogre Might
description: Iron-banded wristguards that lend ferocious melee strength (+2 STR).

name: Cloak of Elvenkind
description: Forest-green mantle woven in Yew (+2 DEX, +1 AC).

name: Talisman of the Triad
description: Gold-filigree holy reliquary (+2 WIS, +4 Max MP).

name: Signet of Arcana
description: Star-sapphire ring pulsing with raw ether (+2 INT, +5 Max MP).

name: Heartstone Amulet
description: Ruby pendant warm to the touch (+8 Max HP, +1 AC).

name: Healing Potion
description: Crimson herbal draught that restores 6–12 HP to a living hero.

name: Greater Healing Potion
description: Concentrated alchemical elixir that restores 12–24 HP to a living hero.

name: Mana Tonic
description: Luminous azure phial that restores 5–11 MP to a spellcaster.

name: Purifying Antidote
description: Blessed silverleaf tincture that cures Poison, Sleep, Paralysis, and Silence (+1–4 HP).

name: Triad Resurrection Salts
description: Sacred temple salts that revive a fallen (Dead) hero or heal a living ally for 6–16 HP.

name: Pitch Torch
description: Resin-soaked pine torch that illuminates dark dungeon corridors for 35 steps.

name: Skeleton Key
description: Forged masterwork lockpick-key that unlocks any barred dungeon door or disarms a chest lock.

name: Angelic Feather
description: Iridescent pinion blessed by the Triad that lifts the entire party out of a dungeon to its surface entrance.
